snippet.title: Matchmaker Dungeon Heart | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

We’ve dropped a Frosty Scoop with this one! Proudly announcing that Matchmaker: Dungeon Heart has set a date for its full, 1.0 release – and that date is today! Open your heart to this 1.0 Announcement Trailer full of exciting match-3 gameplay, tantalising monster dating and… questionable medical practices? Out now on Steam!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507570/Matchmaker_Dungeon_Heart/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
